thread:
noah: Heads-up: BlueDelta wants a fast technical POC to migrate from ProxyAPI -> Redwood. Key asks: compatibility shim, small canonical prompt suite, cost comparison, and answers to their vendor security questionnaire. Can we scope?
anya: We should aim for a 7-10 day POC. Scope: infra + shim, 30 prompts (mix happy/edge/failure), parity evals, and perf numbers.
dmitri: Pricing quick take: ProxyAPI charges per-request with a concurrency add-on. We'll present hosted per-token and a 3-month reserved estimate. For many short responses, token pricing wins. I'll draft two scenarios (2M and 12M tokens/mo).
security-bot: Uploaded vendor pack draft v1: SOC2, KMS notes, data handling addendum. Flag: they want explicit non-use-for-training clause. Legal needs to confirm wording.
netops: We can provision a dedicated staging pool in eu-west-1 and provide egress IPs for their firewall. Need their test CIDR and service account. ETA 48 hours after creds.
anya: Shim notes: translate ProxyAPI params to Redwood equivalents (map sampling params, stop sequences), normalize tokenization, and add a post-processing step to harmonize date formats. Deterministic seed for parity runs.
oah: can someone paste a tiny curl mapping we can hand to their engs to try locally?
dmitri: quick mapping: 
```
# conceptual mapping ProxyAPI -> Redwood
POST /v1/redwood/completions
{
  "model": "rwd-1-lite",
  "prompt": "{{text}}",
  "temperature": 0.5,
  "max_tokens": 128
}
# notes: proxy.top_p -> top_p, proxy.stop -> stop, run tokenizer diff to keep max_tokens budget aligned
```
security-bot: I'll add the pen-test summary and update the non-training clause draft.
anya: Eval plan: run both endpoints on the 30-prompt set, compute embedding cosine and token delta. Acceptance: median cosine >= 0.9, max token increase <= 20%. Manual review for mismatches.
oah: timeline: Day0-1 net + creds; Day1-2 shim + deploy; Day3-4 parity runs; Day5 perf & cost; Day6 demo + contract notes. Owners: netops (infra), anya (shim & eval), dmitri (pricing), security-bot (vendor answers). I'll schedule kickoff with BlueDelta for Monday 9am CET.
anya: also add a smoke harness to replay 100 prompts and generate a CSV of diffs for quick triage.
dmitri: I'll put together the pricing slides and a short TCO table.
oah: great — I'll create presales tasks and loop in legal for the non-training clause. :thumbsup:
